name: Space
description: Space word search puzzles for adults who enjoy a quiet stretch among the stars. These free online grids draw on planets, constellations, telescopes and the slow vocabulary of astronomy — no sci-fi franchises, just real words of the night sky. Pick an easy puzzle for a warm-up, a medium grid with diagonals, or a hard puzzle with reverse words. Play in the browser with large print available, and take as long as you like. Ideal for a focused break when you want something absorbing without noise or timers.
